completion_policy.rule: A simulated model must declare its bus/controller data plane, an injection interface and at least one device on which the UIFlow2 path was exercised. A partial or planned model must declare a concrete blocker. Device manifests must expose the same blocker set. Hardware requirements and modeled components are checked in both directions so a new device cannot hide a peripheral outside its inventory. Every runtime case must declare the exact models it covers, and every simulated component must have a device-local case. A device with any unfinished component must be explicitly allowlisted for temporary backend work; all new devices must be peripheral-complete.

usb-hub-gl852g.data_plane: BCM2837 DWC2 enumerates a GL852G-compatible MTT hub with VID:PID 05e3:0610 and four downstream ports. linux-bcm2837.data_plane: Official CardputerZero ARM64 image boots on QEMU BCM2837 with the physical 512 MiB RAM, M5Stack DTB overlays, panel-mipi-dbi ST7789v3 DRM framebuffer and Linux input events

stickc-plus2-battery-adc.blocker: StickC Plus2 GPIO38 ADC1 channel 2 battery-divider voltage input and the Power API conversion have no device-local model/injection or execution evidence.

dial-gpio-encoder.data_plane: QOM physical detent target schedules real GPIO41/40 quadrature edges through the ESP32-S3 GPIO IRQ controller and the unmodified UIFlow2 RotaryIRQ driver.
dial-gpio-encoder.blocker: Actual GPIO41/40 edges and original RotaryIRQ callbacks were observed, but deferred callbacks can read the same current state and lose detents. The 50ms slow-input operating point is not a fix; representative-load/reversal validation and a new runtime are required.

dial-ws1850s.blocker: Dial WS1850S reset/IRQ and FIFO/CRC driver transactions have not been implemented or validated through the board I2C controller.

ip5306.data_plane: IP5306 I2C register file at 0x75: documented SYS_CTL0/1/2 reset values with reserved-bit write masks, charger CTL0/1/2/3 and CHG_DIG_CTL0 voltage/current requests, READ0/READ1 charge and full flags, READ3 write-1-to-clear key flags, READ4 charge bucket (0xff when no cell is modelled), and boost/power-off request observation through QOM properties; the stock M5Unified IP5306_Class path decodes the same registers
ip5306.blocker: The I2C variant exposes no voltage or current telemetry and this model has no cell, charger or boost power path: battery percentage only appears after a host fixture injects battery-mv, READ4 otherwise returns the explicit 0xff no-cell code, and clearing BOOST bits only records a power-off request instead of changing QEMU power state.

esp32-i2s-dac.data_plane: ESP32 classic I2S0 in DAC mode: the linked-list TX DMA controller model consumes real IDF descriptors and captures the digital sample stream as host PCM; no analog DAC, filter, amplifier, speaker or acoustic behavior is modelled
esp32-i2s-dac.blocker: Digital I2S0 DAC-mode PCM is captured at the DMA boundary only; the on-chip DAC, analog output stage, speaker acoustics, loudness, distortion and physical audio output are not modelled or measured.

ov3660.data_plane: ESP32-S3 LCD_CAM + GDMA RGB565 frame chunks; DVP geometry follows the OV3660 output-size registers 0x3808-0x380b; M5SW_CAMERA_FRAME file injection
ov3660.blocker: Control plane (16-bit SCCB PID/reset/window/PLL) and the RGB565 DVP frame path pass for the official UIFlow2 image, but the MJPEG/UVC path used by the community usb_webcam demo (JPEG SOI) is not modeled, and physical optics/electrical timing are NOT RUN.

sh1107.data_plane: SH1107 monochrome SPI controller: U8g2-compatible command/data stream with 128x16 page GDDRAM, lower/upper column addressing, page address, display on/off, segment remap, COM scan direction, start line/display offset, contrast, multiplex and DC-DC configuration; the model renders the 64x128 glass to a QEMU console and exposes the raw GDDRAM through a QOM dump for offline analysis
sh1107.blocker: GDDRAM/command model only: charge pump, panel timing, contrast/optics and mechanical glass are not modelled. The official factory firmware sends the complete 64x128 init sequence and GDDRAM clear/fill passes but then stalls before its menu drawing, so no final UI frame content is claimed.

mpu9250.data_plane: MPU9250 I2C register file: WHO_AM_I 0x71, INT_STATUS raw-data-ready, PWR_MGMT/CONFIG registers, big-endian accel/temperature/gyro output registers backed by QOM accel-x/y/z and gyro-x/y/z fixtures; a guest MicroPython fixture on the m5stick machine scans 0x68, reads WHO_AM_I and the accel frame through the real ESP32 I2C controller, and a QOM accel fixture change is read back by the guest
mpu9250.blocker: AK8963 magnetometer behind the MPU9250 bypass (0x0C), the DMP and hardware self-test are not modelled; the board's legacy EasyLoader factory firmware does not complete its I2C FIFO transactions against the current classic I2C model, so guest data-plane evidence comes from the generic classic-ESP32 MicroPython fixture rather than the factory firmware.

lepton.data_plane: classic ESP32 HSPI VoSPI: 164-byte packets (segment/line header, 80 big-endian 16-bit pixels), 4 segments x 60 packets per 160x120 frame; deterministic synthetic LWIR fixture selected by frame-seed; 16-bit CCI register interface for PING/serial/FPA+AUX temperature/OEM sync commands

encoder.data_plane: I2C register protocol of the official M5-StickT example: pointer 0x10 = 1-byte switch, pointer 0x00 = 2-byte big-endian delta, pointer 0x20 write clears the delta; QOM-injected increment is read back by the guest

touch-gt911.data_plane: QEMU absolute pointer events drive one GT911 contact in its coordinate/status registers through ESP32-S3 I2C and GPIO48 interrupt; factory firmware touch changes the ET047TC1 framebuffer.

papers3-battery-adc.blocker: The C139 GPIO3 battery-divider ADC conversion and voltage injection are not modeled.

usb-serial-jtag-c6.data_plane: Fixed 64-byte CDC IN/OUT FIFOs at C6 USB Serial-JTAG MMIO; actual guest HWCDC or USB REPL driver uses RAW/ENA/ST/W1C and interrupt-matrix source 48. This model excludes enumeration, EP0 line coding, USB OTG, JTAG and physical signaling.

Only the I2C register contract is modelled: no cell, no charger/boost power path and no voltage/current telemetry. READ4 returns the explicit 0xff no-cell code and battery-mv must be injected by the host; KEY power-off does not change QEMU power state.
I2S0 DAC-mode digital PCM is captured at the DMA boundary, but the analog DAC/amplifier/speaker path and acoustic behavior are not modelled.
The red power key is wired to the IP5306 KEY input rather than an ESP32 GPIO; no QEMU power-key input or power-state transition model exists for this board.
The microSD slot (SPI CLK18/MOSI23/MISO19/CS4) is declared from the official PinMap but has no device-local block backend or case.
